title: Boyle's law
caption: At constant temperature, pressure is inversely proportional to volume: pV is constant, so halving the volume doubles the pressure. A higher temperature gives a larger constant and a curve further out.
alt: Two hyperbolas of pressure against volume: pV = 100 and, at a higher temperature, pV = 150.
description: At the lower temperature, pV = 100 kPa dm³: 50 kPa at 2 dm³, 25 kPa at 4 dm³.
At the higher temperature, pV = 150 kPa dm³: the curve lies above.

checks.name: halving V from 4 to 2 dm³ doubles p from 25 to 50 kPa
